name: The Maybourne Beverly Hills
insider_take: This ultra-luxe newcomer brings British elegance to the heart of Beverly Hills, just steps from Rodeo Drive's legendary shopping scene.
whats_special: The Maybourne Beverly Hills features a stunning rooftop terrace with panoramic views stretching from downtown LA to the Pacific Ocean. The hotel's signature restaurant helmed by a Michelin-starred chef offers an innovative menu that fuses California ingredients with European techniques. Each suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows and Italian marble bathrooms with heated floors.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop bar for sunset cocktails - it's one of the few spots in Beverly Hills where you can see both the Hollywood sign and ocean on clear days.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive shopping concierge service provides after-hours access to Rodeo Drive boutiques. The spa features a unique "Beverly Hills Glow" treatment using 24-karat gold and California botanicals. For culture enthusiasts, the hotel is perfectly positioned between the Los Angeles County Museum of Art and the iconic Beverly Hills Hotel.
pros: Prime Beverly Hills location on Rodeo Drive
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Sophisticated modern design with luxury amenities
World-class dining experiences and rooftop terrace
